host.cpu_model: Apple M1 Pro (8 performance + 2 efficiency cores)

corpus.layout: services/svc-NN/mod_I.rs, file i -> svc (i mod 50), index floor(i / 50); same naming scheme as the inr bench synthetic corpus, 50 service directories, deterministic comment padding to file_bytes_target

design.timing: wall-clock microseconds around each agent process from spawn to exit, taken by benchmarks/measure.py (Python perf_counter_ns around Popen/wait); batch_wall = first agent start to last agent exit (bash EPOCHREALTIME)
design.memory: max_rss_kb = ru_maxrss of the largest process in the agent's reaped process tree (getrusage RUSAGE_CHILDREN), KiB
design.percentiles: nearest-rank over the successful (exit 0) non-warm-up agent samples of a (workload, system, variant, k) group; failures counted separately and excluded from latency and RSS statistics
design.memory_guard: before every batch with k > 1 (each measured trial): skip the rest of the cell when k x (largest successful peak RSS seen so far for the system/variant) > 90% of memory available to this process (Linux: MemAvailable bounded by cgroup memory.max - memory.current + clean non-shmem page cache charged to the cgroup; macOS: physical memory - wired - compressor - anonymous pages); skipped cells listed in skipped_cells with trials_measured and trials_skipped; a cell stopped after some measured trials keeps them
design.k_order: concurrency levels run in ascending order
design.git_isolation: GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM=/dev/null, fixed bench identity, core.fsmonitor=false and feature.manyFiles=true enabled on Git working copies for large-tree fairness, bare origin over file:// with uploadpack.allowFilter; the worktree_add base repository and the bare origin are packed in the foreground (gc --prune=now) before any measurement; provisioning destinations removed between trials
design.inr_isolation: config from inr init with INARCH_* overrides, local fs blob+meta backends, no configured tier cache directories (local-mode processes keep in-memory tiers only), log backend none; land goes through one loopback inr serve (admin bearer token) because the local fs metadata store serialises CAS inside one process only; the land clients run in remote mode, where inr keeps its default on-disk tier-1 blob cache under the redirected HOME inside the scratch tree, shared by the K agents
design.land_verification: after each batch every agent's file is read back from the branch head (git cat-file / inr cat) and counted in agents_ok
design.land_isolation: agent a edits services/svc-<a-1>/mod_0.rs; each inr agent works in a sparse checkout of only its own service directory where .inarch/workspace_state.toml records the workspace base changeset, and inr commit diffs against that persisted base revision and rebases onto the current branch head in O(delta) via land_patch
design.git_push_retry: on a rejected push: git pull --rebase origin main, then push again, up to 500 attempts; attempts recorded in extra
